description: Send an internal message in NOSH ChartingSystem. Log in as demo_provider (password: Provider1234!, practice: Hillside Family Medicine). Navigate to the Messages section and click '+ New Message'. Compose a new message to Dr. Emily Brooks (select from the 'To' dropdown) with subject 'Lab Result Follow-up' and message body: 'Please review the CBC results for patient Conchita Hernandes and let me know if further workup is needed.' Click 'Send' to send the message.
